what: Recorded answers of GET /pilot/v1/participants/{payer}/check to the payee's own agent token, and what valun 0.7.2's valun_check_payer summary (check_summary / checkSummary) and `valun card check` exit code make of each. Both clients are tested on them: python/tests/test_budget_card.py (BothSides) and js/test/budget-card.test.js.
how: The server's own code (lib/pilot/card.mjs checkPayer, over real HTTP: lib/http.mjs and lib/pilot/http.mjs) on the stub world of valun-app test/budget-card.unit.test.mjs (a stub tracker whose signatures verify; tracker v4 capabilities with anchored netting, circulating credit on), with PILOT_NETWORK=valun-testnet-1, a fixed clock (2026-11-15T19:00:00Z) and fixed ids: bob (vp_b0b0b0b0b0b0) pays, alice (vp_a1a1a1a1a1a1) is the payee whose agent token asks, erin (vp_e0e0e0e0e0e0) backs. Each participant's mandate: up to 5000000 a deal, 40000000 in all, plus what the case says. took_ms, the only value that differs from run to run, is written as 3. Two servers: valun-app 103b25f (fix inbox #87: the step's verdict from both sides, payer_side) and valun-app 89832cc, the server/ of this repository (no payer_side; the cover's words among the step's reasons; a payer without a card is 404 card_not_public).
